eps.ov: A blacksmith is forging an enormous sword while a dark man with only one eye and one arm stands back and watches.
eps.oa: حداد يطرق سيفاً هائلاً، بينما يقف رجل قاتم بعين واحدة وذراع واحدة على مسافة منه يراقبه.

eps.ov: There is a great battle taking place at a fort. The attackers are doing well, except one thing stands in their way - a grey knight and he states that none shall pass him.
eps.oa: تدور معركة كبيرة عند حصن، والمهاجمون يحققون تقدماً، إلا أن عقبة واحدة تعترض طريقهم: فارس رمادي يعلن أن أحداً لن يتجاوزه.

eps.ov: Guts and Griffith begin their sword fight.
Guts reminisces about his childhood.
Guts is now a commander of Griffith's army, taking many risks in battle, Casca takes him to task for it. Griffith is knighted in the Midland court much to the nobles' dismay.
eps.oa: صار «غاتس» قائداً في جيش «غريفيث»، ويجازف كثيراً في المعارك، فتؤنبه «كاسكا» على ذلك. ويُمنح غريفيث لقب فارس في بلاط «ميدلاند»، فيستاء النبلاء.

eps.ov: In another raid, Guts and Griffith come across a demon known as Nosferatu Zodd.
eps.oa: في غارة أخرى يصادف «غاتس» و«غريفيث» شيطاناً يُعرف بـ«نوسفيراتو زود».

eps.ov: Princess Charlotte of Midland strikes up a friendship with Griffith.
Griffith and Guts continue their success in battle and Griffith is made a Count.
eps.oa: يواصل «غريفيث» و«غاتس» نجاحاتهما في المعارك، ويُمنح غريفيث لقب كونت.

eps.ov: Griffith saves Charlotte when her horse bolts during a fox hunt. Yurius, the king's younger brother, attempts to have him assassinated.
eps.oa: ينقذ «غريفيث» «شارلوت» حين يجمح بها حصانها في أثناء رحلة لصيد الثعالب. ويحاول «يوريوس»، الأخ الأصغر للملك، أن يدبر اغتياله.

eps.ov: Guts, sent by Griffith, assassinates Yurius and his son Adonis. Griffith gets closer to Charlotte. The Hawks depart for yet another mission.

On a stormy battlefield, Casca, Griffith's second in command, is wounded while fighting the leader of an enemy army. Guts runs to her rescue but when she passes out at the edge of a cliff, he cannot catch her in time and they both fall into the river below.
Casca is still unconscious, so Guts shelters them in a cave while the rain pours down. She comes to and tells Guts about her past and about Griffith's.
Guts and Casca try to fight their way back to the Hawks while the enemy army they were fighting from before try to stop them.

Casca finds Judeau's division of Hawks and leads them back to where Guts was fighting alone. Although injured, he defeated all the enemy soldiers by himself. They return to the Hawks' camp and Casca tends to Guts' wounds.

The King of Midland and his various generals confer about Doldrey Castle, long since captured by the Chudan Empire. Griffith plans an attack and the King agrees despite the protests of his other officers. Only one other general supports Griffith's actions. The Hawks attack Doldrey.
With the help of Nosferatu Zodd, Guts defeats the defender of Doldrey Castle.
With the victory at Doldrey, Griffith is promoted to White Phoenix General, an aristocratic title. The Queen of Midland and other court conspirators try to poison Griffith.
Griffith has his revenge by having the Queen's castle burned down.
Griffith will not let Guts simply leave. He says that Guts belongs to him.

Guts arrives at the home of Godo the swordsmith and stays there for a while while Godo crafts a new sword for him. Guts practices more on his sword techniques with the help of Godo's little daughter Erika.
Guts returns in time to save the remaining Hawks from annihilation.
With Guts help, Casca and the Hawks hope to rescue Griffith.
Breaking away from the King's pursuing armies, the few Hawks left contemplate their future. Guts comforts Casca, who is despondent over Griffith's condition. Griffith begins to dream.
Seduced by the promises of demons and his dreams from his childhood, Griffith agrees to fulfill his destiny and become one of the God Hand demons.
Griffith's men are sacrificed to the demon's appetites. Guts fights on, at first to save Griffith, then to save himself from the result of Griffith's ambition.
